item.title: CPD Kishtwar appeals to religious leaders to verify age before solemnising marriages
item.description: KISHTWAR: In a significant step towards preventing Bal Vivah, the Child Protection Department, Kishtwar, has urged religious leaders and students of Madrasas to strictly verify the age of both bride and groom before solemnising any Nikah or marriage ceremony. item.title: DC Poonch reviews permission for CLU, ensures timely NOC issuance
item.description: POONCH: Deputy Commissioner Poonch, Ashok Kumar Sharma reviewed several cases regarding Change of Land Use (CLU) in a meeting. During the meeting, the DC assessed the performance of the concerned departments in processing CLU cases. A total of 18 cases were discussed, of which 02 cases were approved by the committee, 5 cases were rejected [...]

item.title: DC Poonch chairs DRAC meeting, clears majority of Rent Assessment Cases
item.description: POONCH: Deputy Commissioner Poonch, Ashok Kumar Sharma today chaired a meeting of the District Rent Assessment Committee (DRAC) in the Conference Hall of the DC Office, Poonch. The committee held detailed deliberations with concerned departments and private building owners regarding rent assessment cases of government offices functioning in rented accommodations. item.title: Security Detains Kashmir Resident After Attempt to Offer Namaz at Ram Temple Ayodhya
item.description: JAMMU: A man from Kashmir was detained after he allegedly attempted to offer namaz inside the Ram Mandir complex in Ayodhya, officials said. The incident raised security concerns in the high-security temple area. The individual was identified as Ahmed Sheikh, a 55-year-old resident of Shopian district in Jammu and Kashmir.
